::: {.lead-in}
Interactive demonstrations and notebooks from the [Applied Statistics 2025/26](https://www.nbi.dk/~petersen/Teaching/AppliedStatistics2025.html) course. Every demo runs in your browser. The first load takes a few seconds.
:::

## Week 1: interactive demos

::: {.demo-grid}

::: {.demo-card}
### [Weighted mean and χ²](demos/WeightedMeanSigmaChi2/)
Combine measurements with different uncertainties, and see what the χ² says about them.
:::

::: {.demo-card}
### [Error propagation](demos/ErrorPropagation/)
The error propagation formula against a simulation, with and without correlations.
:::

::: {.demo-card}
### [The χ² test](demos/ChiSquareTest/)
Simulate many experiments and compare their χ² with the χ² distribution.
:::

::: {.demo-card}
### [χ² for three different fits](demos/ChiSquareTest_SeveralExamples/)
A line, an oscillation and a histogram share one χ² distribution.
:::

::: {.demo-card}
### [Anscombe's quartet](demos/AnscombesQuartet/)
Four data sets with the same numbers, and what only a plot shows.
:::

::: {.demo-card}
### [The central limit theorem](demos/CentralLimit/)
Add random numbers from different distributions and watch the sums turn Gaussian.
:::

:::

## Week 2: interactive demos

::: {.demo-grid}

::: {.demo-card}
### [Binomial, Poisson and Gaussian](demos/BinomialPoissonGaussian/)
Three distributions with one mean, and when a χ² fit of counts can be trusted.
:::

::: {.demo-card}
### [Three ways to fit a histogram](demos/FittingMethods/)
χ², binned and unbinned likelihood on the same data, and where they differ.
:::

::: {.demo-card}
### [The principle of maximum likelihood](demos/LikelihoodFit/)
Scan the lifetime, read the uncertainty off the curve, and compare with Minuit.
:::

::: {.demo-card}
### [How long is the table?](demos/TableMeasurements/)
Outlier rejection, pulls and weighted means on 17 years of student measurements.
:::

:::
